covered_report_window: Wednesday, October 28, 2026 after the U.S. market close through Thursday, October 29, 2026 before the U.S. market open
market_context_summary: The FOMC statement arrived at 2:00 p.m. ET and Chair Kevin Warsh's press conference overlaps the final trading hour, while advance Q3 GDP, September PCE and jobless claims arrive at 8:30 a.m. ET before Thursday's open. Oil near $100, elevated long yields and renewed AI-capex scrutiny raise event beta.

ranked_companies.expected_driver: Postpaid account adds, ARPA and service-revenue growth

ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Competitive pressure, churn or slower account growth validates the recent de-rating.

ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Published EPS expectations imply roughly 10% year-over-year growth; evidence is constructive but not uniformly strong.
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: All three passes Lean Up; tight agreement
